features.label: Hollow cheeks
features.vo: One, hollow cheeks. Less volume under the cheekbone, so the face looks sharper.

features.label: Full cheeks
features.vo: Two, full cheeks. More volume here gives the face a softer, rounder look.

features.label: High cheekbones
features.vo: Three, high cheekbones. They sit close to the eyes and lift the whole face.

features.label: Low cheekbones
features.vo: Four, low cheekbones. They sit nearer the mouth, which reads softer and calmer.

features.label: Flat cheekbones
features.vo: Five, flat cheekbones. They barely stick out, so the face looks smooth and even.

features.label: Wide cheekbones
features.vo: Six, wide cheekbones. They are the widest part of the face and frame it.

caption: Hollow, full, high, low, flat or wide. Find yours in the mirror.
